name: git2gdrive
description: Mirror a local git repository's tracked files (git ls-files) to a Google Drive folder. One-directional (local git → Drive): update-in-place, create-if-missing, never deletes. Takes the target Drive folder id as a parameter, or reads it from a Drive URL pinned in the repo AGENTS.md (optional --repo selects a different local work-tree). Requires the gws CLI (authenticated), git, and jq.

interface.shortDescription: Mirror a git repo's tracked files to a Google Drive folder, one-directionally.
